sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def glass(f):
    al=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return {(i,j):al[i][j] for i in range(34,44) for j in range(27,37)}
def air(f):
    al=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return sum(1 for i in range(25,33) for j in range(26,38) if al[i][j]=='B')
# select orange (click orange square ~ row3, col45)
g0=glass(current_frame)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':3,'col':45}])
print('after orange select: air',air(current_frame))
action(['SPACE'])
g1=glass(current_frame)
ch={k:(g0[k],g1[k]) for k in g0 if g0[k]!=g1[k]}
print('C pour with orange: changed',len(ch),'air',air(current_frame))
grid=[['.']*10 for _ in range(10)]
for (i,j) in ch: grid[i-34][j-27]=g1[(i,j)]
for r in grid: print(''.join(r))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def glass(f):
    al=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return {(i,j):al[i][j] for i in range(34,44) for j in range(27,37)}
def air(f):
    al=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return sum(1 for i in range(25,33) for j in range(26,38) if al[i][j]=='B')
# select orange (click orange square ~ row3, col45)
g0=glass(current_frame)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':3,'col':45}])
print('after orange select: air',air(current_frame))
action(['SPACE'])
g1=glass(current_frame)
ch={k:(g0[k],g1[k]) for k in g0 if g0[k]!=g1[k]}
print('C pour with orange: changed',len(ch),'air',air(current_frame))
grid=[['.']*10 for _ in range(10)]
for (i,j) in ch: grid[i-34][j-27]=g1[(i,j)]
for r in grid: print(''.join(r))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
